title: Long Print Progress and ETA
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=octoprint:job state=printing
| stats latest(progress_pct) as progress, latest(eta_epoch) as eta by printer file
| eval finishes=strftime(eta,"%F %T"), remaining_min=round((eta-now())/60,0)
description: Shows the live progress and estimated finish time of running prints so you know when to check on a multi-hour job.
value: Long prints are nerve-wracking; a clear progress and finish time lets you step away without wondering how it is going.
implementation: Ingest live job progress; surface percent complete and estimated finish per active print.
visualization: Progress bars per active print with estimated finish time.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how far along each long 3D print is and when it will finish, so you know when to come back.
